name: xeet
title: Xeet
description: Create and export X post previews locally, render public posts, compare layouts, and save drafts.
author: 0xdhrv

commands.name: create-post
commands.title: Create Post Preview
commands.description: Compose a custom X post and generate a PNG preview.

commands.name: render-post
commands.title: Render X Post
commands.description: Render a public X post URL, plain text, or Xeet Post JSON.

commands.name: compare-layouts
commands.title: Compare Post Layouts
commands.description: Compare themes, surfaces, widths, resolution, and truncation.

commands.name: saved-drafts
commands.title: Saved Drafts
commands.description: Reopen, edit, and export locally saved post drafts.

commands.name: quick-render-clipboard
commands.title: Quick Render Clipboard
commands.description: Render the current clipboard as post text, JSON, or a public X URL.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1

preferences.name: theme
preferences.title: Default Theme
preferences.description: Default Theme used for new previews.

preferences.name: surface
preferences.title: Default Surface
preferences.description: Default Surface used for new previews.

preferences.name: width
preferences.title: Default Width
preferences.description: Default Width used for new previews.

preferences.name: dpr
preferences.title: Default Resolution
preferences.description: Default Resolution used for new previews.

preferences.name: autoClipboard
preferences.title: Read Clipboard
preferences.label: Prefill Render X Post from the clipboard
preferences.description: Read clipboard text when Render X Post opens. Nothing is sent until you generate a preview.

preferences.name: saveHistory
preferences.title: Draft History
preferences.label: Save generated custom posts to Saved Drafts
preferences.description: Keep up to 50 locally saved drafts. Public posts are only saved when requested.

preferences.name: exportDirectory
preferences.title: Export Directory
preferences.description: Save PNG exports here. Defaults to Downloads.

tools.name: create-post-preview
tools.title: Create Post Preview
tools.description: Create an offline custom post PNG with author details and rendering options.

tools.name: render-post
tools.title: Render X Post
tools.description: Render text, Post JSON, a public X URL, a saved draft, or clipboard text as a PNG.

tools.name: inspect-post
tools.title: Inspect Post
tools.description: Check weighted character counts, truncation, and layout without creating an image.

tools.name: compare-post-layouts
tools.title: Compare Post Layouts
tools.description: Generate PNG variants and optional theme/width contact sheets.

tools.name: list-drafts
tools.title: List Saved Drafts
tools.description: Find local draft IDs by title and recency.

tools.name: save-draft
tools.title: Save Draft
tools.description: Save a post locally or update a saved draft while preserving attachments.

tools.name: delete-draft
tools.title: Delete Draft
tools.description: Delete a saved draft after confirmation.

tools.name: export-preview
tools.title: Export Preview
tools.description: Copy a generated PNG or save it to the export directory.
